hook.title: You typed 3 words and expected Claude to read your *mind*

beats.text: The email! You should know what I mean.
I'm smart, but I'm not a mind reader.
Tell me who it's for, and what you want them to do.

panel.title: Say who it's for
panel.html:
make it better
Email to my landlord. The sink has been broken for 3 weeks. I want it fixed by Friday.
politeclear deadlinefirm

beats.text: It's for my landlord. My sink's been broken for three weeks. I want it fixed by Friday.
Perfect. So, polite, with a clear deadline.
Next, paste an email you liked, and I'll copy the tone.

panel.title: Show the tone you want
panel.html:
Write it like this one. deposit_email.txt
"Per section 4.2, the deposit was due back on the 1st. I'd love to close this out by Friday."
Tone: petty, but professional.

beats.text: This one got my deposit back.
Petty, but professional. I love it.
Last, for anything big, ask me to ask you questions first.

panel.title: Let it ask first
panel.html:
Before you write it, ask me 3 questions.
1. Has he replied before?2. What does your lease say about repairs?3. What happens if he misses Friday?

beats.text: Three quick questions now save three rewrites later.
So "make it better" was a bad prompt.
beats.say: So, make it better was a bad prompt.

beats.text: That wasn't a prompt. That was a wish.
